violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment must register an employee certified through an approved food safety management course with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

The hand-washing sink in the front prep area was lacking soap and paper towels. Soap and paper towels must be available at all times for proper hand-washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Prep unit was observed held at 44 degrees Fahrenheit. Foods in this unit observed with temperature of 44 degrees F. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All TCS foods were moved to the walk-in cooler. Service call placed. Prep unit is not to be used to store TCS foods until it is serviced and maintaining a consistent temperature at/below 41 degrees F. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Thermometer was lacking in the prep unit. All cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer inside the unit that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. Thermometer was placed in this unit during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026
Lower prep unit cold drawer is not in good repair. Drawer does not close properly. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/11/2026

The floor and wall junctures on either side of the walk-in cooler do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/12/2025

The floor throughout the facility is in poor repair. Several areas are peeling resulting in an inability to clean effectively. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Floor is to be repaired using materials that are smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment has employees certified in food safety management. One employee certified in food safety management must register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2025

Sanitizer bucket observed in one of the hand-washing sinks. Paper towels were lacking at another hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing and must always be supplied with paper towels for proper hand-washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2025

The floor throughout the facility is in poor repair. Several areas are peeling resulting in an inability to clean effectively. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Floor is to be repaired using materials that are smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2025

The floor and wall junctures on either side of the walk-in cooler do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 12/12/2025
